model_gaps: Borderline abstention: the letter promises intercession with the emperor and armed support against enemies ('Unterstützung bei der Niederwerfung ihrer Feinde'); read as political-military, not a kinship, economic or legal relation. Whether such alliance promises count as rv:Assurance in scope is an open expert question.
The regest names only 'ein Privileg' without its content; rv:RightTypes has no generic privilege type, so no crm:E30_Right node is asserted and rv:RightGrant is used for an unspecified privilege.
